title: Protect Bats From Lava
description: A mod to protect bats from Lava and fire damage. Protect our flappy friends!
body:
Protect Bats From Lava!
=======
Ever gone :( when you are caving, and you hear the sound of a bat, followed precisely 5.4612s later by it 
dying a horrific death to lava? No more! This mod protects bats from lava and fire damage. They will now happily 
flap around on fire without taking any damage.
Protect our flappy friends 🦇❤️!
